facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Hung Nhi Son Pagoda sits quietly on Phu Quoc while the crowds head to the beaches. Incense in the air. No entrance fee. No tour groups. Just locals coming to pray. If you want one hour that feels nothing like the resort strip, this is it. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Incense smoke rising. Monks moving through the courtyard. Zero tourists in sight. Hung Nhi Son Pagoda is the Phu Quoc stop nobody puts in their itinerary. Add it.
